this_week._comment: Dated copies of this week's sessions in the Hevy folder 'This Week'. hevy_push_routines.py (full push, no --only) re-renders every session dated today or later, where today is the lifter's date (TRAINING_TZ, America/New_York), and prints every session it skips with the reason. A session with "done": true is never re-pushed. Next week: rewrite date, slot and title in place and push; the API cannot delete routines, so reuse these ids (add or leave spare ones as needed). A session's optional 'note' (e.g. a race rule) leads that routine's note and its first exercise note.

sessions.title: U1 Upper A (Tue 10 Nov)
sessions.note: R+2 after the 8 Nov race: upper body only, as written.

sessions.title: L2 Lower B (Fri 13 Nov)
sessions.note: Trained Thu 12 Nov, 7:22 pm, as L2 (deadlift 160 x 5 @ 8). The routine was mis-titled 'Fri 13 Nov' by a session running on the UTC date; the title is left as Hevy shows it.

sessions.title: U2 Upper B (Sat 14 Nov)
sessions.note: U2 is the half-session owed after Thursday's L2 (Full B was planned; only its lower half was trained). Press and pulldown were last trained 5 Nov: loads held.

sessions.title: Full C (Sun 15 Nov)
sessions.note: L3 + U3 merged; finishes the pass. 72 h after Thursday's deadlift H (160 x 5 @ 8). If the back or legs are still sore, drop the deadlift V sets (priority-stack drop, not a miss).
